summary: Ask-about-passage: pass chunk id through to the model and genericize the prefilled question
description:
The "Ask guru about this passage" link (askAboutHref, src/lib/read-path.ts:63) drops the chunk id — it only carries ?study=<pin_text_id> and a prefilled question quoting the internal section label (e.g. 'Section 13 (part 64)'). Study-mode retrieval in /api/query is pure semantic search (retrieve(), top-15) and the section label has no overlap with the chunk body, so the referenced passage routinely never reaches the model (observed live: Golden Verses chunk 097 / Theogony — model answered "the passages simply aren't here").

Fix, one addition per hop:
1. askAboutHref (src/lib/read-path.ts): add &chunk=<chunk.id> — reader page already has chunk.id in hand (read/[tradition]/[textId]/[n]/page.tsx:182).
2. chat-view.tsx (~line 139): capture ?chunk= alongside ?study=/?q=, send as pinned_chunk_id with the FIRST query only; follow-ups revert to normal retrieval.
3. api/query/route.ts (~line 145): SELECT the chunk by id, prepend to retrieve() results before buildStudyPrompt — dedupe if retrieval already found it, count it in the token-fitting budget, include in chunks_used/citations. Tag it in the prompt as "the passage the user is reading". Fail-open: unknown id → skip injection, keep today's behavior.

Also: reword the prefilled q in askAboutHref to be generic — with the chunk guaranteed in context, the question should not reference internal chunk/section notation (not meaningful to the text or the model). Something like "What is the meaning of this passage from <text_label>?".

Side observation while investigating: the pythagorean-golden-verses dossier says Section 13 has eleven parts, but chunk 097's section label is "Section 13 (part 64)" — dossier likely predates current chunking; separate ticket if confirmed.
